title: Flows are securable objects in Unity Catalog (Beta)
body: Pipeline flows are now securable objects in Unity Catalog. You can grant `READ FLOW`, `REFRESH FLOW`, `WRITE FLOW`, `APPLY TAG`, and `MANAGE` on individual flows, and `CREATE FLOW` on schemas. To participate in the Beta, contact your Databricks account team. See [Flows in Unity Catalog](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/flows).
